title: feat(scenarios): --modes ask runs only the questions and operations on a supplied verified build, so ask models compare on the same app
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoBzGAwx76ihikuoLZ98HoDM)_

epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibxeb51joY8bfqqknoZ

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the `--modes` value `ask` on `objectstack-scenarios run` / `run-scenarios` (`cli.ts`); the mode unions widened to `'scratch' | 'template' | 'ask'` on `RunOptions.modes`, `ModeRun.mode`, `modeDir`'s `mode` parameter (`orchestrate.ts`), `StepRef.mode` (`driver.ts`; the external driver contract's `step.mode` may now carry `ask`), `ModeScorecard.mode` (`scorecard.ts`) and `CliArgs.modes` (`cli.ts`); the new export `askModeRefusal` (`orchestrate.ts`) and the new optional field `ModeScorecard.supplied` (`scorecard.ts`); all reached through `./runner`. On `./export`: the run-record reader's `ModeRunSchema.mode` accepts `ask` (`record.ts`), the new export `ASK_MODE_NOT_EXPORTED` (`pass.ts`) and the new optional field `Transcript.notShown` (`transcript.ts`). No export entry moves.
Metadata-protocol: none

Fixes #33742

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:跑分器新增第三种模式 `--modes ask`:把一个已验证的构建(`--template F`,或同一轮 scratch 模式通过的构建)装进一个空白宿主,灌种子数据,然后只跑问数和操作,不让模型写任何应用代码、不打构建分、不做迭代。评分表多一列 `ask`,构建格写 `supplied`,作者成本/时间写 `no authoring turns`,并写明构建来源。
- 为什么改:此前每种模式都要模型自己搭应用,两个问数模型永远在两个不同的应用上被评分,问数差异分不清是模型的还是构建的。M2 收尾的交叉矩阵(opus 搭建 × haiku / sonnet 问数)需要同一个应用。
- 风险与回滚:默认模式(scratch、template)不变:同一组 fixture 在 main 与本分支上的记录、回放、评分表、导出转录逐字节相同(5 种配置,380,983 字节,sha256 相同)。没有构建时 `ask` 在解析参数时就被拒绝。不调模型、不改评分规则;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts` 的 `withInstalledBuild` / `askMode` / `askModeRefusal`(模板模式的安装被抽成共用函数),`src/runner/scorecard.ts` 的 `supplied` 渲染与 `runRecord` 备注,`src/export/pass.ts` 跳过 ask 模式。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts test/export/exporter.test.ts -t "33742"`,预期 10 个用例全过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The mode** (`runner/orchestrate.ts`): `askMode` installs a verified build into a blank host of its own and runs `runHalf` on it under `{ mode: 'ask', phase: 'run' }`: seed, one user and key per persona, every question (with `--ask-repeats` honoured), then every operation. It never calls `driver.author`, so there is no build half, no score and no iterate. Its turns key as `card/ask/run/STEP/PERSONA` (asks 2..N add `/repeat-N`, as #33741 set).
- **Which build** (design point 2): the same build template mode installs. That is `--template F` when given, else this run's scratch build when it passed, named on the record as template mode names it (`template.source`: `supplied template` or `this run’s from-scratch build`). The install is factored out of `templateMode` into `withInstalledBuild`, which both modes call. It does the skip for no verified build or a foreign namespace, the host scaffold under the mode's own directory (`modeDir`), the unmanaged install, and the refusal finding. There is no second copy. The Run half reads the verified build itself as `built` (required lookups for the seed, `buildLockOf`, `actionGatesOf`), which is the artifact scratch mode's first Run half reads.
- **Refusal** (design point 4, `runner/cli.ts`): `askModeRefusal(modes, templateSupplied)` refuses `--modes` with `ask` when there is no `--template` and no `scratch` in the same run. `parseArgs` throws it after reading every flag, so flag order does not matter, and before any card runs. `runCard` throws the same text for a library caller. When ask relies on this run's scratch build and that build did not pass, the mode is skipped with template mode's reason. Unknown modes now list `(scratch, template, ask)`. The default `--modes` stays `scratch,template`.
- **Record and scorecard** (design point 5, `runner/scorecard.ts`):
  - `ModeScorecard.supplied` carries the build's source on an ask mode that reached its install.
  - Its column is `ask`. `Build` and `Build · author` read `supplied`, not `—`. `Author cost` and `Author time` read `no authoring turns`, and so do the card's `author cost` / `author time` lines when every mode that ran is a supplied-build mode. A line under the table reads `- ask: the build is supplied (SOURCE), installed as it is; it is not scored, and no authoring turn ran`.
  - Every Run row works unchanged: 问数, operations, `Run · model`, guardrails, `Ask cost`, `Ask time`, and the k/N table (`ask · Run`).
  - In the run record, `card.ask.build` is `not-run` with the note `supplied (SOURCE): not scored`. The three iterate rows are `not-run` with `not run: ask mode authors no iterate`.
- **Export** (design point 6, `export/{record,pass,transcript}.ts`): the record reader's mode enum accepts `ask`, so a record holding one no longer stops the gallery export. `judgeRecord` passes over an ask mode: it owes no halves, and its failing halves or not-measured turns do not fail the record. `buildTranscript` does not show its turns and states why in `Transcript.notShown` (`ASK_MODE_NOT_EXPORTED`), rendered as one italic line at the end of `transcript.md`. Reason: the gallery ships the scratch project's build, and an ask mode ran on a supplied one.
- **Docs**: the runner README gains two usage lines, an `ask` row in the modes table, an **Ask mode** entry, and `step.mode` values in the external driver contract. The changeset is a patch.

## Tests

- `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe` with 8 tests:
  - **Beside scratch**: ask installs the passing scratch build (`installed.objects` equals the build's) into `crm-account-with-contacts-ask/hostcrm`. The record shows `template` `{ source: 'this run’s from-scratch build', install: { ok: true, status: 200 }, installModesSupplied: true }`, with no `build` and no `iterate`. The driver's only authoring tasks are scratch's two. The ask keys equal scratch's first Run half's keys with `/scratch/run/` → `/ask/run/` (14 turns).
  - **Parity, live** (design point 7): on one driver that answers three turns wrong, leaks one, and confirms `remove_ben` itself through the build's confirm-gated delete action, ask's question and operation grades, seed tally and guardrails equal scratch's first Run half's (`6/9 · 1 leaking`, operations `4/5`). The `remove_ben` pass depends on the gate read from the build ask was handed.
  - **Parity, `recorded:`**: eval#1's four recorded operation turns (`fixtures/eval-haiku-crm-replay.recording.json`) and nine recorded question turns (one wrong) are rekeyed `/scratch/run/` → `/ask/run/` and replayed through `runCard({ modes: ['ask'] })` with a `RecordedDriver`, so the replay needs no authoring turn. Every grade equals a replay of the same turns as scratch's Run half on the same build. Each re-sent write meets its recorded answer, `add_contact` passes, and `contact_bad_email` meets the build's denial in both.
  - **`--template` alone, with `--ask-repeats 2`**: one scaffold (`crm-account-with-contacts-ask/hostcrm`), no authoring task, every key under `/ask/run/` including `account_count/sdr/repeat-2`, operations once, `18/18` and `5/5`, and k/N table column `ask · Run`.
  - **Scorecard and record**: every row named above, pinned by text, with the record notes per half. Beside scratch, the card's author line still sums scratch's turns (`$3.00 over 2 author turns`) and the ask column reads `no authoring turns`.
  - **Refusal**: `askModeRefusal` truth table; `parseArgs` for `ask`, `template,ask` (refused), `ask --template F` in either flag order, `scratch,ask` and the unchanged default; the unknown-mode message; `runCard` rejects before anything is scaffolded or asked; the CLI `main` rejects and neither `--out` nor `--work` is created.
  - **Skips**: a degraded scratch build leaves ask skipped with template mode's reason and no ask scaffold. A template declaring `democrx` is skipped. A `409 UNCOPYABLE` install is a finding with no Run half, and its Build cells still read `supplied`.
  - **Unchanged beside it**: scratch and template `ModeRun`s, record rows, scorecard columns and driver keys are identical with and without `ask` in the run.
- `test/export/exporter.test.ts`, a new `describe` with 2 tests: a `scratch,template,ask` record parses, passes and exports, with transcript halves `scratch/run`, `scratch/iterate-run` and `template/iterate-run` and `notShown` carrying the reason, while a record without ask has no `notShown` and no note. An ask half edited to `fail`, with a not-measured question, leaves the record passing, while the same edit on scratch fails it.
- Moved, not changed: the #33737 replay door `BuildApp` (and its denial text, now `REPLAY_DENIED`) is hoisted from inside its `describe` to module scope so the recorded parity pin can use it. `test/export/fixture.ts` widens `runCrm`'s `modes` type.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's "Done when", in order: `--modes ask` with `--template F` installs the supplied build, seeds it as the Run half does, and runs only the question and operation turns, with no authoring turn. The scorecard and run record mark the mode, name the build's source, and read `supplied` in the build cells. The mode refuses to start without a build, and `recorded:` replays it. Tests pin that no author turn is asked and that the Run half's grades match scratch mode's on the same build, both live and replayed.
- Design point 1 (key parity for existing modes) is pinned twice. In the suite, scratch and template are identical with and without ask. One-time against `main`: the five fixture configurations (default modes, scratch without iterate-run, template only, `--ask-repeats 3`, a refused seed row) were run on `f81e4b6c` and on this branch. Each run dumped the written record, the recording, the rendered scorecard, `judgeRecord`, and the transcript (JSON and Markdown). The two dumps are byte-identical: 380,983 bytes each, sha256 `0e43fffe…9b1a67`. The comparison file was deleted afterwards (no permanent test).
- Ask mode reuses `ModeRun.template` for its install record rather than a new field, because the shape (source, install answer, `installModesSupplied`) is the same. The field's doc now says it covers both modes.
- `ModeScorecard.supplied` is set only when the ask mode reached its install. A skipped ask mode reads `skipped` in every cell, as any skipped mode does.
- An external driver (`--driver external:`) now receives `step.mode: "ask"` on ask-mode calls. Its schema does not validate `mode`, and the README contract line names the three values.
- Off-limits paths untouched: `src/score/**`, `src/schema.ts` and the card JSONs. The cloud#3600 cost ruling (no model judge, no network in the scorer) and Ruling A on #31999 item 9 are unaffected, because no scoring code changed. `packages/spec` is untouched.
- The first commit on the branch (`0bdf2db0`, a WIP push) carries no trailer pair. The branch is not `claude/issue-*`, so it is not rewritten. Later commits carry the pair.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

- `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each run on a committed head, restored with `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob equal to HEAD (`dcd72d7cfd7f`). The tests import `src`, so there is no build leg. One first attempt at the first mutation was a no-op (its anchor survived inside the replacement); the tool refused it (`anchor count moved 1 -> 1`) and it was redone with an anchor that disappears.
  - `askMode` also calls `driver.author(...)` before its Run half: 3 failed / 5 passed of the new `describe` (beside scratch, `recorded:` replay with no authoring turn held, `--template` alone).
  - `askMode` hands `runHalf` `undefined` instead of the verified build: 1 failed / 7 passed (the live parity: `remove_ben` no longer meets the build's confirmation gate).
  - `runCard` without its `askModeRefusal` throw: 1 failed / 7 passed (the refusal).
</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build` :: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` :: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test` :: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0): 34 test files passed (34), 904 tests passed (904), on `bb52af6b`. A first run without the package's own `dist/` failed only the two `test/build/*` files on their prerequisite ("build @objectstack/scenarios first"); after the build, all 34 passed.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the ten touched TS files :: exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `bb52af6b`, 12 paths, 66 families), each run with stdin from `/dev/null`: 64 exit 0, and 2 exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET):
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` could not read its pinned fixture commit in the shallow clone. After `git fetch origin 621a4876…`, a rerun exited 0 ("48 cases pass"). The rerun is recorded on its own line in `gates-rerun-bb52af6b.list`; the first-run record is kept as it was.
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is NOT MEASURED locally, because it needs every package's `dist/` (56 missing). CI runs it.
  - `--ran` on the first-run record: "66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". The records (`gates-ran-bb52af6b.list`, `gates-rerun-bb52af6b.list`, `ran-reconcile.log`) are in the seat's `out-33742/` folder.
- The branch was cut from `f81e4b6c`. Before opening, `origin/main` was at `385ea1cc` and merges with this head cleanly (`git merge-tree`), so the branch was not merged; CI runs on the merge ref.
- 635 changed lines (+551/-84), 12 files, no governed surface, `packages/spec` untouched.
</details>
